source_trigger.condition: PowerTaskList BLOCK_DEATH -> character ZONE tag 49 becomes GRAVEYARD 4; not simply health<=0

death_wave_order.not_waiting: damage splat end or voice end

death_wave_order.event: choose one character death voice; suppress others; activate character effects for all dying targets
base controller completes task callback; DoCurrentTaskList applies zone changes
zone Play->Graveyard launches standard type5 on retained old Actor

voice.exception: Card.ActivateSoundSpell waits while game option 39 is true. This is a boolean gate, not a one-frame delay or damage/voice-end callback.

logical_vs_visual_removal: ZONE->GRAVEYARD model update precedes old visual Actor retention. The 3.5s callback destroys old Actor, not a delayed rules death or necessarily Entity destruction.

normal_body_timeline.event: type5 Birth starts AllyInPlay_Death and authored generic sound; shake runs .5 seconds
normal_body_timeline.boundary: origin is original zone-transition callback; simulator maps its visible death wave to this origin

normal_body_timeline.event: PrepareForDeathAnimation invokes keyword Death, including frozen/taunt/sleep when active
RootObject renderers off; fragment subtree renderers on; child particle play; start collision-plane tween with 1.5 second delay and 1.5 second duration
collision plane movement begins, not whole debris-group translation
disable shadow; Spell enters None; old Actor destroyed and spells released

damage.route: Card.OnMetaData 0x06012d78 uses spell type7 and DamageSplat.SetDamage then Action3
damage.ownership: Damage splat under Actor/Spells is separate from hidden RootObject; may overlap body/keyword death until release
damage.type10_death_splat: Direct call sites are InputManager.ShowSkull lethal attack preview (0x06005a5f), DisableSkull (0x06005a61), and HistoryItem.DisplaySkullOnActor (0x060058e1). Not an automatic ordinary death effect; do not add to Destroy/Corruption.

materials.portrait: GetCardPortraitTextureAction 0x06016b77 -> old ancestor Actor -> GetStaticPortraitTexture 0x06012892. Raw source portrait; not full-card screenshot; action does no UV/resize.
materials.per_actor_material: SetMaterial 0x06000059 / SetMaterialTexture 0x0600006c -> MaterialService RendererExtension; index0 renderer.material accessor. Keep per-Actor material isolation.
materials.nonpremium: PremiumMaterialSwitcher 0x06015335 with premium<1 and absent original cache leaves serialized defaults.
materials.root_binding: SpellInitActorVariables.GetActor 0x06016d08 prefers ancestor Actor; OnEnter 0x06016d0a binds RootObjectMesh to Actor.GetMeshRenderer(true).
materials.placement: standard ActivateDeathSpell does not SetSource; preserve actor/spells parent and original local prefab transforms, despite m_Location=2.

particles.wrapper: CustomActions Runtime ParticlePlayAction.OnEnter 0x060000ee: if target has PS, PS.Play(includeChildren); if no PS and includeChildren=true, enumerate children and each.Play(true).
particles.simulation_space: public enum Local0,World1,Custom2 verified, but raw serialized moveWithTransform=0 is NOT proven same encoding; do not force-map.
particles.visibility: SetVisibilityRecursiveAction.OnEnter 0x06000112 unconditionally sets enabled on every returned renderer. Initially disabled rock renderer can become enabled at .5 if active descendant.
particles.boundary: Unity native subemitter play scheduling, collision solver, particle culling, moveWithTransform serialization bridge, and exact RNG sequence not recovered by managed CIL.

itween.shake: ApplyShakePositionTargets 0x06000054: offset per-axis uniform random +-amount*(1-percentage), relative to cached start, not accumulated, default world isLocal=false; no sine approximation.
itween.move: ApplyMoveToTargets 0x0600004e; easeType21 uses linear 0x0600009b. Animate only FX_CollisionPlaneLocation1.
itween.rng: presentation randomness must not consume rule RNG

hero_boundary.trigger: Card.Check_HeroToGraveyard 0x06012e28: prior ZoneHero -> ZoneGraveyard calls oldActor.DoCardDeathVisuals immediately at IL001b; no minion .3 delay.
hero_boundary.independent_endgame: GameEntity.ActivateSpellForDestroyedHero 0x060054f3 selects endgame body effects, but does not itself call keyword death. Original packet interval unavailable.
hero_boundary.integration: Do not clear frozen at generic game_over; map explicit hero graveyard presentation transition if available, documenting atomic simulator compatibility origin.

polymorph.semantics: same normal Actor update; changed frozen/taunt tags may run their own Death, no type5 body or character death VO. Unchanged active status instance is retained.

projected_shadow.boundary: No proof that a generic 2D oval is equivalent. Source disable at 3.5 is known; projection rendering remains a separate compatibility boundary.
